title: Stratagem
description: Whenever you shuffle your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], choose [blue]1[/blue] card from it to put into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
smart_description: Whenever you shuffle your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], choose [blue]cards[/blue] from it to put into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. The number you can choose equals your current stack count.
notes: Counter-type power that scales with each additional stack. Each stack allows you to choose one additional card from the Draw Pile when it shuffles.
